image_description: A large African crocodile (Nile crocodile) resting on a muddy riverbank with its mouth slightly open. The crocodile's body is elongated and heavily armored with visible scutes along its back. The head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout. The eyes are positioned dorsally on the head. The crocodile is surrounded by dry vegetation and mud.
